package.name: cuvslam_bringup
package.description: ROS 2 bringup and thin C++ wrapper for cuVSLAM-based stereo visual-inertial odometry using the Intel RealSense T265 fisheye stereo pair and IMU. Publishes raw odometry and relies on odom_tf_relay (from realsense_camera_bringup) to adapt it into the rover's odom -> ackermann/base_link contract.
